transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 692 Barkerview Court?
Yeah, this is me at 692 Barkerview Court—just the four of us here, no water inside, and we’re all good to stay put, no need to come get us.
How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There’s four of us here total, and everyone’s able to answer the phone—no one’s stuck inside or can’t come to the line.

Thanks for letting us know everyone’s reachable. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own, not even a wheelchair or oxygen user—everyone’s fine and mobile, no motorized chairs or anything like that.
Thanks for confirming everyone is mobile and able to leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, thanks for asking—just the four of us here, all good to go, no need for any truck or boat or seats, we’re totally fine.
Glad to hear everyone is safe and dry. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and I don’t have any free seats—everyone’s safe and dry right here at 692 Barkerview Court, no need for a ride out.
Thanks for letting us know everyone’s safe and dry. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—four of us, all safe and dry inside, no water in yet, and we’re good to stay put for now.
Thanks for confirming you’re all safe and dry inside. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
